about: A ranked list with bars whose rows slide into their new order on a word: things sorted by a measure, a league table, how a ranking changed when the numbers changed.

values.about: each thing's value, in the same order

then.about: new values; the rows re-rank by them when the cue comes

order.about: down puts the largest first, up the smallest

highlight.about: one thing drawn in the accent

cue.about: a word whose saying starts the reordering

when.about: moments each row arrives, then the moment it reorders; else when they are said, or one after another
